title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy one million orbital data centers
summary: The FCC authorized SpaceX on November 25 to deploy up to one million orbital compute modules for its Starmind constellation, the first U.S. authorization for a constellation of data centers in space. The order allows radiofrequency backup telemetry, tracking and command links, and optical inter-satellite links backed by 18.8-19.3 GHz downlink and 28.6-29.1 GHz uplink communications. Other orbital data center proposals remain under review.
